params.1273: Enter the courtyard of Draynor Mansion.
params.1274: Follow the road north out of Lumbridge.
params.1275: Pass the chicken farm and wheat fields and continue until you reach the crossroads.
params.1276: At the crossroads, head north through the dead woods until you reach Draynor Manor.
params.1277: Walk through the gates to enter the courtyard.
params.1292: This Beginner Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
